display.title: Episode 471: The Lost Letter, Chapter 1 (Before Pesach)
display.summary_short: Burn your own 'chametz', the yetzer hara, before Pesach; Shema with a young guest; and the first chapter of The Lost Letter, about a wealthy Chassid who did not ask the Baal Shem Tov for a blessing.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in the last days before Pesach 5751. Uncle Yossi teaches that when we burn the chametz we should ask Hashem to help us get rid of our own 'chametz', the yetzer hara, so we can feel the true freedom of Zman Cheiruseinu; when Moshiach comes, all evil will disappear. The order of the day: tell the yetzer hara its time is up. After the Hakochainik march, a young guest recites the Shema in Studio 604 and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time begins The Lost Letter: on his last day, the Baal Shem Tov blesses his students, but Reb Leib, the richest man in town, feels he needs nothing. The Baal Shem Tov instead gives him a sealed letter to deliver to Reb Sholom. Coming home in a storm, Reb Leib drops it unnoticed under a heavy closet and forgets it, and over the following years one disaster after another strips away his fortune. To be continued. The program ends with the Shabbos candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: Never think you have no need for a blessing: good fortune can turn, and a tzaddik's brachah opens new channels of blessing. Before Pesach, ask Hashem to help you burn your own 'chametz', the yetzer hara.

date.note: 'So very close to Pesach'; Shabbos candles 5:52 fits Friday 22 March 1991 in New York; one week before episode 472, which states Yud-Aleph Nissan.

advisories.note: The story opens as the Baal Shem Tov blesses his students before his passing.
A wealthy man loses his fortune through a series of fires and disasters.

privacy.note: The child reciting the Shema is named in full.

sources_cited.note: The prayer said three times a day that all evil be removed.

segments.title: Burning Our Own Chametz: Freedom from the Yetzer Hara
segments.summary: As we burn the chametz, we ask Hashem to help us get rid of the yetzer hara; when Moshiach comes, all evil will be removed.

segments.title: The Lost Letter, Chapter 1
segments.summary: Reb Leib declines a blessing from the dying Baal Shem Tov, loses the letter he was asked to deliver, and watches his fortune slip away.
